ShopUp is a next-gen shopping app concept that personalises the experience using AI-driven recommendations.ShopUp is a next-gen shopping app concept that personalises the experience using AI-driven recommendations.

The case study explores a minimalist, user-centric approach to mobile shopping and follows a full design-thinking process, from research to high-fidelity UI.

The challenge

Research surfaced recurring pain points, including:

  • “I often get delayed or wrong deliveries, and the tracking information isn’t clear or updated.”
  • “I get overwhelmed navigating through the app filters, menus, and categories aren’t intuitive.”

The approach

Unlike generic e-commerce giants, ShopUp is designed with the user at the centre: a smarter, more personalised shopping experience using AI-powered recommendations that understand taste, needs and budget.

A clutter-free interface, fast delivery and real-time customer support aim to make shopping seamless, not stressful, while curated collections, exclusive deals and local seller support help people discover unique products.

The details

The ShopUp mark combines a delivery truck and a shopping basket into one fast-moving cart. It stands for quick deliveries and a seamless experience, while the bold blue conveys trust, reliability and innovation.

how it landed

OutcomeOutcome

A concept project, so these are the results it is designed for, not live numbers.

What I delivered

  • User research and usability testing with six participants
  • Persona, empathy map and competitive analysis
  • Information architecture, user flows and wireframes
  • Style guide, high-fidelity UI and the ShopUp logo

How I’d measure success

  • Time to find a product using filters
  • Checkout completion
  • Support questions about where an order is (clearer tracking should cut them)
  • Repeat orders from recommendations

What it shows

  • A full design-thinking process, from research to UI
  • Turning real pain points (tracking, filters) into features
  • Brand and product design working together
